notes.title: Battlegun Mobile
notes.content: Hi everybody. The mobile version of our best-selling game will be released soon. In terms of size reduction and mobile compatibility, only the Town map will be on the mobile. If enough interest is seen in Mobil, new weapons will be added to the PC version with an update.

notes.title: New Game
notes.content:
[b]Hi guys,[/b]

I started developing a new strategy game. and I need your support. For now, I published the free version in itch.io. If you wish to try the game you can download it for free.

[b]Download:[/b] [url=https://khanate.itch.io/khanate]https://khanate.itch.io/khanate[/url]

notes.title: Thanks for playing!
notes.content:
There was a lot of interest in our game this week. Hundreds of players have entered the game. Game rooms were always active. Thank you everyone who plays our game lovingly. Thank you for choosing us to spend your time.

[h1]What should we add to your game?[/h1]

> New maps?
> New guns?
> Knife, Bomb
> All
